description: This file provides a generic implementation of background process management including spawning, communication, and cleanup. It manages subprocess lifecycle, version handshake, capabilities negotiation, and process termination within a Git-related infrastructure.

classes.name: subprocess_entry
classes.description: Represents a managed subprocess, including command details and process state.

classes.name: child_process
classes.description: Encapsulates the details of a child process used in subprocess management.

methods.name: int cmd2process_cmp(const void * cmp_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for subprocess entries based on command string.

methods.name: struct:subprocess_entry * subprocess_find_entry(struct hashmap * hashmap,const char * cmd)
methods.description: Finds a subprocess entry in the hashmap by command name.

methods.name: int subprocess_read_status(int fd,struct strbuf * status)
methods.description: Reads and extracts the status from a subprocess via a file descriptor.

methods.name: void subprocess_stop(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry)
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up a subprocess entry.

methods.name: void subprocess_exit_handler(struct child_process * process)
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a subprocess exits.

methods.name: int subprocess_start(struct hashmap * hashmap,struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * cmd,subprocess_start_fn startfn)
methods.description: Initializes and starts a subprocess, handling necessary setup.

methods.name: int handshake_version(struct child_process * process,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version)
methods.description: Performs version handshake with a subprocess to agree on protocol version.

methods.name: int handshake_capabilities(struct child_process * process,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Negotiates capabilities with the subprocess during startup.

methods.name: int subprocess_handshake(struct subprocess_entry * entry,const char * welcome_prefix,int * versions,int * chosen_version,struct subprocess_capability * capabilities,unsigned int * supported_capabilities)
methods.description: Coordinates version and capability handshake process with the subprocess.
